label: Apple iMac 24-inch (M3)
description: 24-inch all-in-one with Apple M3, Wi-Fi 6E and Gigabit Ethernet built into the external power adapter.
notes: The 1GbE RJ45 physically lives in the external power brick, not the chassis - standard on 10-core GPU configs and optional on the base model. Wi-Fi 6E onboard; worth modelling because the 'port' is not where students expect it.
